_what_this_is: Where else this same business exists on the web, and how to reach it.
sameAs is how you tell Google that the Google Business Profile, the G2
listing, the Capterra listing and this website are ONE company rather than
four unrelated things with similar names. It is one of the stronger signals
behind a Knowledge Panel, and it is worth filling in properly.
It is only worth anything if every URL is real and resolves. A sameAs
pointing at a listing that does not exist is a claim Google can check and
find false. So this file ships EMPTY rather than with plausible guesses,
and the build refuses any entry that is not an https:// URL.
HOW TO FILL IT IN: open each listing in a browser, copy the address bar
exactly, and paste it into the list below. Do not shorten it, do not remove
the query string if the site put one there. Then rebuild:
and re-upload site/. Leave out any listing that is still 'in review': add
it once it is live and you can open it yourself.
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored by the build.
_email_note: The public contact address for the business, e.g. admin@theschoolmanager.site.
This one is baked into the page's structured data, which is why it is here
and not in config.js: config.js is read by the browser at runtime and the
structured data has to exist in the HTML that Google fetches.
Leave it empty and no email is claimed.
